title: Italy Stuck Between Fragile Industry and Explosive Budget Politics · 18 Aug
keywords: Italy economy, Italian industrial production, Italy budget, bank levy, eurozone fiscal policy, Italian coalition, EU fiscal rules, Italy recession risk, Italian wages, euro area economy
notes: Italy's industrial output fell 1.0% in June, reinforcing concerns that the country's economic recovery remains brittle even as the government insists its cautious fiscal strategy is working. A parallel coalition fight over taxing banks to fund public priorities has added instability to an already uncertain outlook. For the eurozone's third-largest economy, the stakes extend well beyond Rome.
